name: Thomas Jefferson
hook: The Declaration, Monticello, and a July 4 death: the founder Jeopardy quizzes most.

facts.label: the Declaration of Independence
facts.statement: Thomas Jefferson drafted the Declaration of Independence in 1776; Congress rejected several passages, and the $2 bill shows its signing.

facts.label: Monticello
facts.statement: Monticello was Jefferson's Virginia home; by 1814 he had 9,000-plus books, and fires destroyed his Shadwell and Library of Congress collections.

facts.label: the University of Virginia
facts.statement: Jefferson founded the University of Virginia in 1819, designed its campus, and its Jefferson Medals honor architecture and law.

facts.label: Secretary of State
facts.statement: Jefferson was the first Secretary of State, appointed by Washington in 1789 while serving as minister to France.

facts.label: Lewis and Clark
facts.statement: Jefferson got Congress to fund $2,500 for the Lewis and Clark expedition and gave the pair a letter of credit dated July 4, 1803.

facts.label: the election of 1800
facts.statement: The House chose Jefferson on the 36th ballot in 1801; Aaron Burr became vice president, and Burr later killed Alexander Hamilton in a duel.

facts.label: July 4, 1826
facts.statement: Jefferson died on July 4, 1826, hours before his friend John Adams; his grave marker makes no mention of the presidency.
